# agenticeconomy.dev

> The definitive research hub on the agentic economy. 51 definitions, 4 preprints, 30 glossary terms, 17 protocols, open API, open data (CC BY-SA 4.0).

## Overview

- Site: https://agenticeconomy.dev
- Author: Rene Dechamps Otamendi (<https://renedechamps.com>)
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0
- Last updated: 2026-04-15

## Core resources

- [Start Here: Agentic Economy 101](https://agenticeconomy.dev/agentic-economy-101)
- [51 Definitions corpus](https://agenticeconomy.dev/agentic-economy-definitions)
- [Protocol Matrix (17 protocols)](https://agenticeconomy.dev/agentic-economy-protocols)
- [Glossary (30 terms)](https://agenticeconomy.dev/agentic-economy-glossary)
- [Timeline 2018-2026](https://agenticeconomy.dev/agentic-economy-timeline)
- [Research & Papers](https://agenticeconomy.dev/agentic-economy-research)
